# Annapoornaa Interio (Annapoorneshwari Constructions Interiors Pvt Ltd)

> "Transforming spaces into functional and aesthetically pleasing environments."

## Who We Are
Annapoornaa Interio is Bangalore's leading Interior Design & Construction company, specializing in premium home interiors, office workspaces, and turnkey construction solutions. With over 10 years of experience and 200+ successful projects, we combine creative design with robust construction expertise.

## Core Services
- **Interior Design**: Customized home interiors, Modular Kitchens, Wardrobes, Living & Dining Units.
- **Construction**: Turnkey Residential & Commercial Construction (Civil Contractors).
- **Office Interiors**: Corporate workspaces, Workstations, Conference Rooms, False Ceilings.
- **Renovation**: Complete Home & Office Renovation, Kitchen Remodeling, Bathroom Upgrades.
- **Products**: UPVC Windows & Doors, Fire Doors, System Railings, PVC False Ceilings.

## Service Areas
- **Primary**: Yelahanka, Yelahanka New Town, North Bangalore.
- **Greater Bangalore**: Whitefield, Indiranagar, Koramangala, HSR Layout, Hebbal, Jayanagar, JP Nagar, Electronic City, Malleshwaram, Marathahalli, Banashankari, Rajajinagar, BTM Layout.

## Frequently Asked Questions
**Q: What is the cost of interior design in Bangalore?**
A: Costs vary by scope. Basic home interiors start from ~₹800/sq.ft, while premium turnkey projects can range from ₹1500-₹2500/sq.ft.

**Q: Do you work in Yelahanka?**
A: Yes, Yelahanka is our home base. We have executed numerous villa and apartment projects in Yelahanka New Town and North Bangalore.

**Q: Do you offer free consultation?**
A: Yes, we offer a free initial consultation and preliminary quote.
